what: Photo cells lined up horizontally are staggered odd/even (even cells sit 37.5% of their own height lower), and each time the slider advances one cell, all cells swap up and down — a curve that rests .1s, then at .8s pulls back slightly the other way before overshooting in, so the whole strip ripples like a wave. Even if the slider clones cells and inserts them, odd/even is repainted by order

options.every: Auto-flip interval (seconds), default 0 — at 0 it flips only when the host sends an fx:step event to the panel (from slick beforeChange or Swiper slideChangeTransitionStart)
options.drop: Push of the cells moving down, default 37.5% (ratio of the cell’s own height, px also allowed)
options.first: First cell goes down (down, default) or up
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell that bounces (one slide of the slider — the slide itself, not the inside of slick-slide)

from.where: index.html .ak-gallery__slider — original .home-gallery-slider (slick centerMode·variableWidth·autoplay 2000·speed 800) flips moved on .home-gallery-slide in beforeChange, translate(0,37.5%) .8s .1s cubic-bezier(.68,-.55,.265,1.55)
